name: Nukleus Office Solutions Ltd
title: Nukleus Office Solutions Ltd - 544370 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Flex-workspace operator guiding to ~10 lakh sq ft operational by FY27 end (from ~3.5 lakh), but gave no revenue numbers, and fixed assets up 160% with debt-funded expansion and thin disclosure quality.

utilisation.quote: We maintain healthy occupancy levels of around 85%

capex.quote: fixed assets grew by 160.71% year on year to 35 25.36 lakhs, driven by continued investments in workspace infrastructure

triggers.label: Fixed assets up 160.71% YoY
triggers.quote: fixed assets grew by 160.71% year on year to 35 25.36 lakhs

triggers.label: Operational area ~3.5 lakh → 10 lakh by FY27
triggers.quote: we will be ending the year with more than a million operational area

triggers.label: Occupancy ~85%, no change disclosed
triggers.quote: We maintain healthy occupancy levels of around 85%

triggers.label: No revenue guidance; declined to quantify
triggers.quote: putting a number to this will not be a good idea

guidance.quote: we will be ending the year with more than a million operational area
over a period of next three to four years will come down to 90% of managed office and 10% of co-working

red_flags.label: Revenue mix chart errors acknowledged
red_flags.quote: There seems to be some error from 25 to 26

red_flags.label: Finance cost figure inconsistent with debt rise
red_flags.quote: The finance cost has increased modestly to around 11.5 lakhs from the earlier 92.75 lakhs

red_flags.label: Asked to name clients; management declined
red_flags.quote: I don't know if the client name has to be disclosed.

red_flags.label: Accounting shift to Ind AS-style reporting, not GAAP-comparable NDS
red_flags.quote: we are going to soon getting our accounts converted to index in this financial year itself

evasions.topic: Revenue potential from 3.5 lakh sq ft
evasions.quote: putting a number to this will not be a good idea
It's a 3 months investment cycle for establishing the center
our partners are telling us not to take names
